verdicts.reason: A keeps a single centered column, so the bottom half is jammed: the CTA nearly touches the legal text, the legal runs into the bottom edge, the bottom-left circle sits under the fine print, 'SUNSET SALE' has dropped below the headline, the logo is crammed into the top-right corner and the can is shrunk to a small sliver. B uses a sensible can-left, copy-right split with the can at a readable size and a clear headline, then CTA stack, but the tiny logo floats off the text column's axis, the CTA is oversized and competes with '30% OFF', and the four-line legal block is cramped at the bottom right.
